note: No Scripture is quoted or echoed in this volume, so the references list is empty.

Title follows the series pattern (« Courageux pour Dieu : Livre quatre »); the subtitle reuses Book Two's French subtitle because the English subtitles are identical; chapter titles follow Book Two's « Nom : l’… qui … » shape, and C.T. is written « C. T. » as in the shipped French Studd title.

Miles converted to kilometres as the series does (two miles → trois kilomètres; twenty-five miles → quarante kilomètres); « the Cambridge Seven » → « les Sept de Cambridge »; « Ida Scudder » chapter title renders « Three Knocks » as « qui entendit frapper trois fois ».

In chapter 6 « Ida offered to come and help » is rendered « Ida proposa qu’on vienne aussitôt les aider », since historically she offered her doctor father, not herself (she had no medical training then); two English factual slips were translated in corrected form (see english_errors).
